title.zh: 卷六十七 表第七 方鎮四
title.raw: 卷六十七 表第七 方鎮四 Volume 67 Tables 7: Military Commanderies 4

translations.literal: 710 CE, first year of the Jingyun reign.
translations.idiomatic: 710 CE, first year of the Jingyun reign.

sentences.zh: 安西都護四鎮經略大使。

translations.literal: The Anxi Protector-General held the post of Four Garrisons frontier commissioner-general.
translations.idiomatic: The Anxi Protector-General served as Four Garrisons frontier commissioner-general.

sentences.zh: 置河西諸軍州節度、支度營田督察九姓部落、赤水軍兵馬大使，領涼、甘、肅、伊、瓜、沙、西七州，治涼州。

translations.literal: The Hexi Various Army Prefectures military, branch disbursement, garrison farm, Nine Tribes inspection, and Chishui Army military commissioner-general was established, holding Liang, Gan, Su, Yi, Gua, Sha, and Xi prefectures—seven in all—with seat at Liang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Hexi military commissioner with branch disbursement, garrison farm, Nine Tribes oversight, and Chishui Army command was appointed over seven prefectures—Liang, Gan, Su, Yi, Gua, Sha, and Xi—from Liang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 西元 南陽 山南西道 荊南 安西 河西 隴右 劍南

translations.literal: Western calendar [CE]. Nanyang. Shannan West Circuit. Jingnan. Anxi. Hexi. Longyou. Jiannan.
translations.idiomatic: CE dates. Columns: Nanyang; Shannan West; Jingnan; Anxi; Hexi; Longyou; Jiannan.

sentences.zh: 副使治甘州，領都知河西兵馬使。

translations.literal: The deputy commissioner had his seat at Gan Prefecture and concurrently held the post of director-general of Hexi military and horses.
translations.idiomatic: The deputy commissioner was stationed at Gan Prefecture, also serving as director-general of Hexi military forces.

sentences.zh: 712 先天元年 北庭都護領伊西節度等使。

translations.literal: 712, first year of the Xiantian era. The Beiting Protector-General concurrently held the Yixi frontier commissioner and related posts.
translations.idiomatic: In 712, the first year of Xiantian, the Beiting Protector-General was also appointed Yixi frontier commissioner.

translations.literal: 713, first year of the Kaiyuan era.
translations.idiomatic: 713 CE, first year of the Kaiyuan reign.

sentences.zh: 河西節度使兼隴右群牧都使、本道支度營田等使。

translations.literal: The Hexi military commissioner concurrently held the Longyou herd commissioner-general post and this circuit's branch disbursement, garrison farm, and related posts.
translations.idiomatic: The Hexi military commissioner also served as Longyou herd commissioner-general and as this circuit's branch disbursement and garrison farm commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以益州長史領劍南道支度營田、松當姚巂州防禦處置兵馬經略使。

translations.literal: The Yizhou chief secretary concurrently held the Jiannan Circuit branch disbursement and garrison farm commissioner post and the Song-Dang-Yao-Xi prefectures defense, disposal, military, and frontier commissioner post.
translations.idiomatic: The chief secretary of Yizhou Prefecture also served as Jiannan Circuit branch disbursement and garrison farm commissioner and as defense, disposal, military, and frontier commissioner for Song, Dang, Yao, and Xi prefectures.

sentences.zh: 安西大都護領四鎮諸蕃落大使。

translations.literal: The Anxi Grand Protector-General concurrently held the post of commissioner to the various tribal peoples of the Four Garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: The Anxi Grand Protector-General was also appointed commissioner to the various tribes of the Four Garrisons.

sentences.zh: 置隴右節度，亦曰隴西節度，兼隴右道經略大使，領秦、河、渭、鄯、蘭、臨、武、洮、岷、廓、疊、宕十二州，治鄯州。

translations.literal: The Longyou military commissioner was established, also called Longxi military commissioner, concurrently holding the Longyou Circuit frontier commissioner-general post, holding Qin, He, Wei, Shan, Lan, Lin, Wu, Tao, Min, Kuo, Die, and Dang prefectures—twelve in all—with seat at Shan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Longyou military commissioner—also called Longxi military commissioner—was appointed as Longyou Circuit frontier commissioner-general over twelve prefectures—Qin, He, Wei, Shan, Lan, Lin, Wu, Tao, Min, Kuo, Die, and Dang—from Shan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 安西都護領四鎮節度、支度經略使，副大都護領磧西節度、支度、經略等使，治西州。

translations.literal: The Anxi Protector-General held the posts of Four Garrisons military, branch disbursement, and frontier commissioner; the deputy grand protector-general held the Qixi military, branch disbursement, frontier, and related posts, with seat at Xi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Anxi Protector-General was appointed Four Garrisons military, branch disbursement, and frontier commissioner; the deputy grand protector-general served as Qixi military, branch disbursement, and frontier commissioner from his seat at Xi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 719 七年 河西節度增領經略大使。

translations.literal: 719, seventh year. The Hexi circuit military commissioner added concurrent authority as frontier commissioner-general.
translations.idiomatic: In 719, the seventh year of Kaiyuan, the Hexi military commissioner also took the frontier commissioner-general post.

sentences.zh: 升劍南支度、營田、處置、兵馬經略使為節度使，兼昆明軍使，領益、彭、蜀、漢、眉、綿、梓、遂、邛、劍、榮、陵、嘉、普、資、巂、黎、戎、維、茂、簡、龍、雅 、瀘、合二十五州，治益州。

translations.literal: The Jiannan branch disbursement, garrison farm, disposal, and military frontier commissioner was promoted to military commissioner, concurrently holding the Kunming Army commissioner post, holding Yi, Peng, Shu, Han, Mei, Mian, Zi, Sui, Qiong, Jian, Rong, Ling, Jia, Pu, Zi, Xi, Li, Rong, Wei, Mao, Jian, Long, Ya, Lu, and He prefectures—twenty-five in all—with seat at Yi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiannan branch disbursement, garrison farm, disposal, and military frontier commissioner was elevated to full military commissioner, also serving as Kunming Army commissioner and commanding twenty-five prefectures—Yi, Peng, Shu, Han, Mei, Mian, Zi, Sui, Qiong, Jian, Rong, Ling, Jia, Pu, Zi, Xi, Li, Rong, Wei, Mao, Jian, Long, Ya, Lu, and He—from his seat at Yi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 分伊西、北庭置二節度使。

translations.literal: Yixi and Beiting were split and two military commissioners were established.
translations.idiomatic: Yixi and Beiting were separated, each receiving its own military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 隴右節度副使兼關西兵馬使。

translations.literal: The Longyou military deputy commissioner concurrently held the Guanxi military horses commissioner post.
translations.idiomatic: The Longyou deputy military commissioner also served as Guanxi military horses commissioner.

sentences.zh: 合伊西、北庭二節度為安西四鎮北庭經略、節度使。

translations.literal: The Yixi and Beiting two military commissioners were merged into the Anxi Four Garrisons Beiting frontier and military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Yixi and Beiting military commissions were combined as the Anxi Four Garrisons Beiting frontier and military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 劍南節度兼山南西道採訪處置使，號山劍西道，增領文、扶、姚三州。

translations.literal: The Jiannan military commissioner concurrently held the Shannan West Circuit investigation and disposal commissioner post, was styled Shannan-Jiannan West Circuit, and added Wen, Fu, and Yao prefectures—three in all—to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiannan military commissioner also served as Shannan West investigation and disposal commissioner, took the name Shannan-Jiannan West Circuit, and gained jurisdiction over Wen, Fu, and Yao prefectures.

translations.literal: The Jiannan military commissioner added Feng Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiannan military commissioner gained jurisdiction over Feng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 復分置安西四鎮節度，治安西都護府。北庭伊西節度使，治北庭都護府。

translations.literal: Anxi Four Garrisons military commissioner was again established separately, with seat at the Anxi Protectorate. The Beiting-Yixi military commissioner was established, with seat at the Beiting Protectorate.
translations.idiomatic: The Anxi Four Garrisons military commissioner was restored with headquarters at the Anxi Protectorate; a separate Beiting-Yixi military commissioner was posted to the Beiting Protectorate.

sentences.zh: 以張掖郡太守領河西節度副使。

translations.literal: The Zhangye Commandery grand administrator concurrently held the Hexi circuit military deputy commissioner post.
translations.idiomatic: The grand administrator of Zhangye Commandery was also appointed Hexi deputy military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 劍南節度增領保寧都護府。

translations.literal: The Jiannan military commissioner added the Baoning Protectorate to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiannan military commissioner gained jurisdiction over the Baoning Protectorate.

sentences.zh: 安西四鎮復兼北庭節度。是年，復置二節度。

translations.literal: Anxi Four Garrisons again concurrently held Beiting military commissioner. In the same year, two military commissioners were again established.
translations.idiomatic: Anxi Four Garrisons again took the Beiting military commission. That year two separate military commissioners were restored.

translations.literal: 756 CE, first year of the Zhide reign.
translations.idiomatic: 756 CE, first year of the Zhide reign.

sentences.zh: 襄陽、南陽二郡皆置防禦守捉使，尋升南陽防禦為節度使。

translations.literal: Defense and garrison commissioners were established for both Xiangyang and Nanyang commanderies; soon the Nanyang defense commissioner was promoted to military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Defense and garrison commissioners were appointed for Xiangyang and Nanyang commanderies, and the Nanyang defense commissioner was soon elevated to military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 742 天寶元年 劍南節度增領霸州。

translations.literal: 742, first year of the Tianbao era. The Jiannan circuit military commissioner added Ba Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 742, the first year of Tianbao, the Jiannan military commissioner gained jurisdiction over Ba Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 置興平節度使，領上洛、安康、武當、房陵四郡，治上洛郡。

translations.literal: The Xingping military commissioner was established, holding Shangluo, Ankang, Wudang, and Fangling commanderies—four in all—with seat at Shangluo Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: A Xingping military commissioner was appointed, commanding four commanderies—Shangluo, Ankang, Wudang, and Fangling—from his seat at Shangluo.

sentences.zh: 置山南西道防禦守捉使。

translations.literal: The Shannan West Circuit defense and garrison commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: A defense and garrison commissioner for the Shannan West Circuit was created.

translations.literal: The Kuizhou defense and garrison commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: A Kuizhou defense and garrison commissioner was established.

sentences.zh: 河西節度兼隴右河西北路，未幾而罷。

translations.literal: The Hexi military commissioner concurrently held the Longyou Hexi North Route post; before long this was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Hexi military commissioner also took charge of the Longyou Hexi North Route, but the arrangement was soon discontinued.

sentences.zh: 天水郡太守兼防禦守捉使及大震關使。

translations.literal: The Tianshui Commandery grand administrator concurrently held the defense and garrison commissioner post and the Dazhen Pass commissioner post.
translations.idiomatic: The grand administrator of Tianshui Commandery also served as defense and garrison commissioner and commissioner of Dazhen Pass.

sentences.zh: 廢南陽節度使，升襄陽防禦使為山南東道節度使，領襄、鄧、隋、唐、安、均、房、金、商九州，治襄州。

translations.literal: The Nanyang military commissioner was abolished; the Xiangyang defense commissioner was promoted to Shannan East Circuit military commissioner, holding Xiang, Deng, Sui, Tang, An, Jun, Fang, Jin, and Shang prefectures—nine in all—with seat at Xiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Nanyang military commissioner was abolished and the Xiangyang defense commissioner elevated to Shannan East military commissioner, commanding nine prefectures—Xiang, Deng, Sui, Tang, An, Jun, Fang, Jin, and Shang—from Xiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 置荊南節度，亦曰荊澧節度，領荊、澧、朗、郢、復、夔、峽、忠、萬、歸十州，治荊州。

translations.literal: The Jingnan military commissioner was established, also called Jing-Li military commissioner, holding Jing, Li, Lang, Ying, Fu, Kui, Xia, Zhong, Wan, and Gui prefectures—ten in all—with seat at Jing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Jingnan military commissioner—also called Jing–Li military commissioner—was appointed over ten prefectures—Jing, Li, Lang, Ying, Fu, Kui, Xia, Zhong, Wan, and Gui—from Jing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 升夔州防禦為夔峽節度使。

translations.literal: The Kuizhou defense commissioner was promoted to Kuixia military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Kuizhou defense commissioner was elevated to Kuixia military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 更劍南節度號西川節度使，兼成都尹，增領果州。

translations.literal: The Jiannan circuit military commissioner was redesignated West Chuan military commissioner, concurrently holding the Chengdu magistrate post, and Guo Prefecture was added to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiannan military commissioner became the West Chuan military commissioner, also serving as Chengdu magistrate, with Guo Prefecture added to his command.

sentences.zh: 以梓、遂、綿、劍、龍、閬、普、陵、瀘、榮、資、簡十二州隸東川節度。

translations.literal: Zi, Sui, Mian, Jian, Long, Lang, Pu, Ling, Lu, Rong, Zi, and Jian prefectures—twelve in all—were placed under the East Chuan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve prefectures—Zi, Sui, Mian, Jian, Long, Lang, Pu, Ling, Lu, Rong, Zi, and Jian—were transferred to the East Chuan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 758 乾元元年 廢夔峽節度使。

translations.literal: 758, first year of the Qianyuan era. The Kuixia military commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In 758, the first year of Qianyuan, the Kuixia military commissioner was abolished.

sentences.zh: 置興、鳳二州都團練守捉使，治鳳州。

translations.literal: The Xing-Feng Two Prefectures chief training and garrison commissioner was established, with seat at Feng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A chief training and garrison commissioner for Xing and Feng prefectures was appointed, stationed at Feng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 置澧朗漵都團練使，治澧州。

translations.literal: The Li-Lang-Xu chief training commissioner was established, with seat at Li Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Li–Lang–Xu chief training commissioner was appointed, with his seat at Li Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以夔、峽、忠、歸、萬五州隸夔州。

translations.literal: Kui, Xia, Zhong, Gui, and Wan prefectures—five in all—were placed under Kuizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Five prefectures—Kui, Xia, Zhong, Gui, and Wan—were transferred to Kuizhou jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 760 上元元年 廢澧朗漵都團練使。

translations.literal: 760, first year of the Shangyuan era. The Li-Lang-Xi chief training commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In 760, the first year of Shangyuan, the Li–Lang–Xi chief training commissioner was abolished.

translations.literal: The Jingnan military commissioner concurrently held the Jiangling magistrate post.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingnan military commissioner also served as Jiangling magistrate.

sentences.zh: 荊南節度復領澧、朗、忠、峽四州。

translations.literal: The Jingnan military commissioner again took jurisdiction over Li, Lang, Zhong, and Xia prefectures—four in all.
translations.idiomatic: Jurisdiction over Li, Lang, Zhong, and Xia prefectures was restored to the Jingnan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 廢興平節度使，置武關內外四州防禦觀察使，領州如故。

translations.literal: The Xingping military commissioner was abolished; the Wuguan Inner and Outer Four Prefectures defense and observation commissioner was established, holding prefectures as before.
translations.idiomatic: The Xingping military commissioner was abolished and replaced by a defense and observation commissioner for the four prefectures inside and outside Wuguan Pass, with jurisdiction unchanged.

sentences.zh: 荊南節度增領涪、衡、潭、岳、郴、邵、永、道、連九州。

translations.literal: The Jingnan military commissioner added Fu, Heng, Tan, Yue, Chen, Shao, Yong, Dao, and Lian prefectures—nine in all—to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingnan military commissioner gained nine prefectures—Fu, Heng, Tan, Yue, Chen, Shao, Yong, Dao, and Lian.

translations.literal: 762 CE, first year of the Baoying reign.
translations.idiomatic: 762 CE, first year of the Baoying reign.

translations.literal: Jin and Shang prefectures—two in all—were placed under the Capital Region.
translations.idiomatic: Jin and Shang prefectures were transferred to Capital Region jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 罷武關內外四州防禦觀察使。

translations.literal: The Wuguan Inner and Outer Four Prefectures defense and observation commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The defense and observation commissioner for the four prefectures inside and outside Wuguan Pass was abolished.

sentences.zh: 劍南節度增領通、巴、蓬、渠四州，尋以四州隸山南西道，其後又領松、當、悉、柘、翼、恭、靜、環、真九州。

translations.literal: The Jiannan military commissioner added Tong, Ba, Peng, and Qu prefectures—four in all—to its jurisdiction; soon these four prefectures were placed under the Shannan West Circuit; afterward it again took jurisdiction over Song, Dang, Xi, Zhe, Yi, Gong, Jing, Huan, and Zhen prefectures—nine in all.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiannan military commissioner gained Tong, Ba, Peng, and Qu prefectures, but soon those four were transferred to the Shannan West Circuit; later it resumed command of nine prefectures—Song, Dang, Xi, Zhe, Yi, Gong, Jing, Huan, and Zhen.

translations.literal: 763 CE, first year of the Guangde reign.
translations.idiomatic: 763 CE, first year of the Guangde reign.

sentences.zh: 升山南西道防禦守捉使為節度使，尋降為觀察使，領梁、洋、集、壁、文、通、巴、興、鳳、利、開、渠、蓬十三州，治梁州。

translations.literal: The Shannan West Circuit defense and garrison commissioner was promoted to military commissioner; soon it was reduced to observation commissioner, holding Liang, Yang, Ji, Bi, Wen, Tong, Ba, Xing, Feng, Li, Kai, Qu, and Peng prefectures—thirteen in all—with seat at Liang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Shannan West defense and garrison commissioner was elevated to military commissioner, but soon reduced to observation commissioner, commanding thirteen prefectures—Liang, Yang, Ji, Bi, Wen, Tong, Ba, Xing, Feng, Li, Kai, Qu, and Peng—from his seat at Liang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 荊南節度罷領忠、涪二州，以衡、潭、邵、永、道五州隸湖南觀察使。

translations.literal: The Jingnan military commissioner discontinued jurisdiction over Zhong and Fu prefectures—two in all; Heng, Tan, Shao, Yong, and Dao prefectures—five in all—were placed under the Hunan observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingnan military commissioner relinquished Zhong and Fu prefectures; Heng, Tan, Shao, Yong, and Dao prefectures were transferred to the Hunan observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 置夔忠涪都防禦使，治夔州。

translations.literal: The Kuizhong-Fu chief defense commissioner was established, with seat at Kuizhou.
translations.idiomatic: A chief defense commissioner for Kuizhong-Fu was appointed, with his seat at Kuizhou.

sentences.zh: 劍南西川節度復領東川十五州。

translations.literal: The Jiannan West Chuan military commissioner again took jurisdiction over the East Chuan fifteen prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The West Chuan military commissioner resumed command of the East Chuan fifteen prefectures.

sentences.zh: 765 永泰元年 荊南節度罷領岳州。

translations.literal: 765, first year of the Yongtai era. The Jingnan military commissioner discontinued jurisdiction over Yue Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 765, the first year of Yongtai, the Jingnan military commissioner relinquished Yue Prefecture.

translations.literal: 766 CE, first year of the Dali reign.
translations.idiomatic: 766 CE, first year of the Dali reign.

sentences.zh: 荊南節度復領澧、朗、涪三州。

translations.literal: The Jingnan military commissioner again took jurisdiction over Li, Lang, and Fu prefectures—three in all.
translations.idiomatic: Jurisdiction over Li, Lang, and Fu prefectures was restored to the Jingnan military commissioner.

translations.literal: The Hexi military commissioner's seat was moved to Sha Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Hexi military headquarters were transferred to Sha Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 置邛南防禦使，治邛州，尋升為節度使，未幾廢。

translations.literal: The Qiongnan defense commissioner was established, with seat at Qiong Prefecture; soon it was promoted to military commissioner, and before long it was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: A Qiongnan defense commissioner was posted to Qiong Prefecture, soon elevated to military commissioner, but abolished before long.

sentences.zh: 置劍南西山防禦使，治茂州，未幾廢。

translations.literal: The Jiannan Western Mountains defense commissioner was established, with seat at Mao Prefecture; before long it was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: A Jiannan Western Mountains defense commissioner was posted to Mao Prefecture, but the office was soon abolished.

sentences.zh: 復以十五州還東川節度。

translations.literal: The fifteen prefectures were again returned to the East Chuan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The fifteen prefectures were once more transferred back to the East Chuan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 鎮西復為安西，其後增領五十七蕃使。

translations.literal: Zhenxi was again changed to Anxi; afterward it added jurisdiction over fifty-seven tribal commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenxi was restored to Anxi, and later gained authority over fifty-seven tribal commissions.

translations.literal: The Jiannan military commissioner added Qian Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiannan military commissioner gained jurisdiction over Qian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 780 建中元年 升山南西道觀察使為節度使。

translations.literal: 780, first year of the Jianzhong era. The Shannan West Circuit observation commissioner was promoted to military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 780, the first year of Jianzhong, the Shannan West observation commissioner was elevated to military commissioner.

translations.literal: 784 CE, first year of the Xingyuan reign.
translations.idiomatic: 784 CE, first year of the Xingyuan reign.

translations.literal: 785 CE, first year of the Zhenyuan reign.
translations.idiomatic: 785 CE, first year of the Zhenyuan reign.

translations.literal: The Jin-Shang Two Prefectures chief defense commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: A chief defense commissioner for Jin and Shang prefectures was appointed.

sentences.zh: 山南西道節度使兼興元尹，增領果、閬二州。

translations.literal: The Shannan West Circuit military commissioner concurrently held the Xingyuan magistrate post, and Guo and Lang prefectures—two in all—were added to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Shannan West military commissioner also served as Xingyuan magistrate, with Guo and Lang prefectures added to his command.

translations.literal: Guo Prefecture was placed under the Shannan West Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Prefecture was transferred to Shannan West jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 785 貞元元年 鄧州隸東都畿。

translations.literal: 785, first year of the Zhenyuan era. Deng Prefecture was placed under the Eastern Capital Metropolitan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 785, the first year of Zhenyuan, Deng Prefecture was transferred to the Eastern Capital Metropolitan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 山南東道節度增領復州。

translations.literal: The Shannan East Circuit military commissioner added Fu Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Shannan East military commissioner gained jurisdiction over Fu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 涇原節度使兼領安西四鎮、北庭節度。

translations.literal: The Jingyuan military commissioner concurrently held the Anxi Four Garrisons and Beiting military commissioner posts.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingyuan military commissioner also took command of the Anxi Four Garrisons and Beiting military commissions.

translations.literal: An Prefecture was placed under the Fengyi Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: An Prefecture was transferred to the Fengyi Army military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 西川節度增領統押近界諸蠻及西山八國雲南安撫使。

translations.literal: The West Chuan military commissioner added concurrent authority as unified barbarian-suppression commissioner for nearby tribes and commissioner for pacification of the Western Mountains Eight Kingdoms and Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: The West Chuan military commissioner also took unified command of nearby tribes and the Yunnan pacification commission for the Western Mountains Eight Kingdoms.

sentences.zh: 805 永貞元年 西川節度增領古州。

translations.literal: 805, first year of the Yongzhen era. The West Chuan military commissioner added Gu Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 805, the first year of Yongzhen, the West Chuan military commissioner gained jurisdiction over Gu Prefecture.

translations.literal: 806, first year of the Yuanhe era.
translations.idiomatic: 806 CE, first year of the Yuanhe reign.

translations.literal: Fu Prefecture was placed under the Qianzhong military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Prefecture was transferred to the Qianzhong military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 西川節度復領資、簡二州。

translations.literal: The West Chuan military commissioner again took jurisdiction over Zi and Jian prefectures—two in all.
translations.idiomatic: Jurisdiction over Zi and Jian prefectures was restored to the West Chuan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 置唐隋鄧三州節度使，治唐州。

translations.literal: The Tang-Sui-Deng Three Prefectures military commissioner was established, with seat at Tang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Tang–Sui–Deng military commissioner was appointed, with headquarters at Tang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 廢唐隋鄧節度使，是年復置，徙治隋州。

translations.literal: The Tang-Sui-Deng military commissioner was abolished; in the same year it was again established, and its seat was moved to Sui Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang–Sui–Deng military commissioner was abolished but restored the same year, with headquarters transferred to Sui Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 廢唐隋鄧節度使，以唐、隋、鄧三州還隸山南東道。

translations.literal: The Tang-Sui-Deng military commissioner was abolished; Tang, Sui, and Deng prefectures—three in all—were returned to the Shannan East Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang–Sui–Deng military commissioner was abolished, and Tang, Sui, and Deng prefectures were restored to Shannan East jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 山南東道節度增領臨漢監牧使。

translations.literal: The Shannan East Circuit military commissioner added concurrent authority as Linhan pasture commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Shannan East military commissioner also took the Linhan pasture commissioner post.

translations.literal: 821, first year of the Changqing era.
translations.idiomatic: 821 CE, first year of the Changqing reign.

translations.literal: 825, first year of the Baoli era.
translations.idiomatic: 825 CE, first year of the Baoli reign.

translations.literal: 827, first year of the Dahe era.
translations.idiomatic: 827 CE, first year of the Dahe reign.

sentences.zh: 廢荊南節度使，置都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: The Jingnan military commissioner was abolished; a chief training and observation commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingnan military commissioner was abolished and replaced by a chief training and observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 山南東道節度罷臨漢監牧使。

translations.literal: The Shannan East Circuit military commissioner discontinued the Linhan pasture commissioner post.
translations.idiomatic: The Shannan East military commissioner relinquished the Linhan pasture commission.

translations.literal: 836, first year of the Kaicheng era.
translations.idiomatic: 836 CE, first year of the Kaicheng reign.

translations.literal: The Jingnan military commissioner was again established.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingnan military commissioner was restored.

translations.literal: 841, first year of the Huichang era.
translations.idiomatic: 841 CE, first year of the Huichang reign.

sentences.zh: 廢山南東道節度，是年復置。

translations.literal: The Shannan East Circuit military commissioner was abolished; in the same year it was again established.
translations.idiomatic: Shannan East military command was abolished but restored the same year.

translations.literal: 847, first year of the Dazhong era.
translations.idiomatic: 847 CE, first year of the Dazhong reign.

sentences.zh: 荊南節度復領涪州，未幾，復以涪州隸黔中。

translations.literal: The Jingnan military commissioner again took jurisdiction over Fu Prefecture; before long, Fu Prefecture was again placed under Qianzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Jurisdiction over Fu Prefecture was restored to the Jingnan military commissioner, but soon Fu Prefecture was transferred back to Qianzhong.

sentences.zh: 升秦州防禦守捉使為秦成兩州經略、天雄軍使。

translations.literal: The Qinzhou defense and garrison commissioner was promoted to Qin-Cheng Two Prefectures frontier and Tianxiong Army commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Qinzhou defense and garrison commissioner was elevated to frontier commissioner of Qin and Cheng prefectures and commissioner of the Tianxiong Army.

sentences.zh: 置歸義軍節度使，領沙、甘、瓜、肅、鄯、伊、西、河、蘭、岷、廓十一州，治沙州。

translations.literal: The Guiyi Army military commissioner was established, holding Sha, Gan, Gua, Su, Shan, Yi, Xi, He, Lan, Min, and Kuo prefectures—eleven in all—with seat at Sha Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Guiyi Army military commissioner was appointed, commanding eleven prefectures—Sha, Gan, Gua, Su, Shan, Yi, Xi, He, Lan, Min, and Kuo—from Sha Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 秦成兩州經略領押蕃落副使。

translations.literal: The Qin-Cheng Two Prefectures frontier commissioner concurrently held the barbarian-suppression deputy commissioner post.
translations.idiomatic: The Qin–Cheng frontier commissioner also served as barbarian-suppression deputy commissioner.

translations.literal: 860, first year of the Xiantong era.
translations.idiomatic: 860 CE, first year of the Xiantong reign.

sentences.zh: 置涼州節度，領涼、洮、西、鄯、河、臨六州，治涼州。

translations.literal: The Liangzhou military commissioner was established, holding Liang, Tao, Xi, Shan, He, and Lin prefectures—six in all—with seat at Liang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Liangzhou military commissioner was appointed over six prefectures—Liang, Tao, Xi, Shan, He, and Lin—from Liang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 河、鄯、西三州隸涼州節度。

translations.literal: He, Shan, and Xi prefectures—three in all—were placed under the Liangzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He, Shan, and Xi prefectures were transferred to the Liangzhou military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 升秦成兩州經略、天雄軍使為天雄軍節度、觀察、處置、營田、押蕃落等使，增領階州。

translations.literal: The Qin-Cheng Two Prefectures frontier and Tianxiong Army commissioner was promoted to Tianxiong Army military, observation, disposal, garrison farm, and barbarian-suppression commissioner and related posts, and Jie Prefecture was added to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Qin–Cheng frontier and Tianxiong Army commissioner was elevated to Tianxiong Army military, observation, disposal, garrison farm, and barbarian-suppression commissioner, with Jie Prefecture added to his command.

sentences.zh: 置定邊軍節度，觀察、處置、統押近界諸蠻並統領諸道行營兵馬制置等使，領巂、眉、蜀、邛、雅、嘉、黎七州，治邛州。

translations.literal: The Dingbian Army military commissioner was established as observation, disposal, unified barbarian-suppression commissioner for nearby tribes, and regional commissioner of the various circuits' expeditionary military and related posts, holding Xi, Mei, Shu, Qiong, Ya, Jia, and Li prefectures—seven in all—with seat at Qiong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Dingbian Army military commissioner was appointed with observation, disposal, and unified command of nearby tribes and expeditionary forces, commanding seven prefectures—Xi, Mei, Shu, Qiong, Ya, Jia, and Li—from Qiong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 西川節度復領統押近界諸蠻等使，又增領管內制置、指揮兵馬等使。

translations.literal: The West Chuan military commissioner again took the unified barbarian-suppression commissioner and related posts, and additionally added concurrent authority as circuit internal regional and military director commissioner and related posts.
translations.idiomatic: The West Chuan military commissioner resumed unified command of nearby tribes and also gained circuit internal regional and military director commissions.

sentences.zh: 廢定邊軍節度使，復以巂、眉、蜀、邛、雅、嘉、黎七州隸西川節度。

translations.literal: The Dingbian Army military commissioner was abolished; Xi, Mei, Shu, Qiong, Ya, Jia, and Li prefectures—seven in all—were again placed under the West Chuan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Dingbian Army military commissioner was abolished, and seven prefectures—Xi, Mei, Shu, Qiong, Ya, Jia, and Li—were restored to the West Chuan military commissioner.

translations.literal: 874, first year of the Qianfu era.
translations.idiomatic: 874 CE, first year of the Qianfu reign.

translations.literal: 880, first year of the Guangming era.
translations.idiomatic: 880 CE, first year of the Guangming reign.

translations.literal: 881, first year of the Zhonghe era.
translations.idiomatic: 881 CE, first year of the Zhonghe reign.

sentences.zh: 置保勝軍防禦使，治眉州。綿、漢二州皆置防禦使。

translations.literal: The Baosheng Army defense commissioner was established, with seat at Mei Prefecture. Defense commissioners were established for both Mian and Han prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: A Baosheng Army defense commissioner was appointed at Mei Prefecture, and defense commissioners were also appointed for Mian and Han prefectures.

translations.literal: The Pengzhou defense commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: A Pengzhou defense commissioner was appointed.

translations.literal: 885 CE, first year of the Guangqi reign.
translations.idiomatic: 885 CE, first year of the Guangqi reign.

sentences.zh: 升金商都防禦使為節度，兼京畿制置萬勝軍等使。是年，罷節度，置昭信軍防禦使，治金州。

translations.literal: The Jin-Shang chief defense commissioner was promoted to military commissioner, concurrently holding the Capital Region regional commissioner of Wansheng Army and related posts. In the same year, the military commissioner post was abolished; the Zhaoxin Army defense commissioner was established, with seat at Jin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin–Shang chief defense commissioner was elevated to military commissioner, also serving as Capital Region regional commissioner of the Wansheng Army. That year the military commissioner post was abolished and replaced by a Zhaoxin Army defense commissioner stationed at Jin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 升興、鳳二州都團練守捉使為防禦使，治鳳州。

translations.literal: The Xing-Feng Two Prefectures chief training and garrison commissioner was promoted to defense commissioner, with seat at Feng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The chief training and garrison commissioner for Xing and Feng prefectures was elevated to defense commissioner, stationed at Feng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 置武定軍節度使，治洋州。

translations.literal: The Wuding Army military commissioner was established, with seat at Yang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Wuding Army military commissioner was appointed, with his seat at Yang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 升興、鳳二州防禦使為感義軍節度使。

translations.literal: The Xing-Feng Two Prefectures defense commissioner was promoted to Ganyi Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The defense commissioner for Xing and Feng prefectures was elevated to Ganyi Army military commissioner.

translations.literal: 888 CE, first year of the Wende reign.
translations.idiomatic: 888 CE, first year of the Wende reign.

sentences.zh: 賜山南東道節度號忠義軍節度。

translations.literal: The Shannan East Circuit military commissioner was granted the title Zhongyi Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Shannan East military commissioner was given the name Zhongyi Army military commissioner.

translations.literal: The Ganyi Army military commissioner added Li Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Ganyi Army military commissioner gained jurisdiction over Li Prefecture.

translations.literal: Cheng Prefecture was placed under the Weirong Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Prefecture was transferred to the Weirong Army military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 置永平軍節度使，領邛、蜀、黎、雅四州，治邛州。升彭州防禦使為威戎軍節度使，領彭、文、成、龍、茂五州，治彭州。

translations.literal: The Yongping Army military commissioner was established, holding Qiong, Shu, Li, and Ya prefectures—four in all—with seat at Qiong Prefecture. The Pengzhou defense commissioner was promoted to Weirong Army military commissioner, holding Peng, Wen, Cheng, Long, and Mao prefectures—five in all—with seat at Peng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Yongping Army military commissioner was appointed at Qiong Prefecture over four prefectures—Qiong, Shu, Li, and Ya. The Pengzhou defense commissioner was elevated to Weirong Army military commissioner, commanding five prefectures—Peng, Wen, Cheng, Long, and Mao—from Peng Prefecture.

translations.literal: 889, first year of the Longji era.
translations.idiomatic: 889 CE, first year of the Longji reign.

translations.literal: 890, first year of the Dashun era.
translations.idiomatic: 890 CE, first year of the Dashun reign.

sentences.zh: 武定軍節度增領階、扶二州。

translations.literal: The Wuding Army military commissioner added Jie and Fu prefectures—two in all—to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Wuding Army military commissioner gained jurisdiction over Jie and Fu prefectures.

sentences.zh: 廢永平軍節度使，以邛、蜀、黎、雅四州復隸西川節度使。

translations.literal: The Yongping Army military commissioner was abolished; Qiong, Shu, Li, and Ya prefectures—four in all—were again placed under the West Chuan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongping Army military commissioner was abolished, and Qiong, Shu, Li, and Ya prefectures were restored to the West Chuan military commissioner.

translations.literal: 892 CE, first year of the Jingfu reign.
translations.idiomatic: 892 CE, first year of the Jingfu reign.

sentences.zh: 武定軍節度增領閬、果二州。是年，以閬州隸龍劍節度。

translations.literal: The Wuding Army military commissioner added Lang and Guo prefectures—two in all—to its jurisdiction. In the same year, Lang Prefecture was placed under the Long-Jian military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Wuding Army military commissioner gained Lang and Guo prefectures. That year Lang Prefecture was transferred to the Long-Jian military commissioner.

translations.literal: Peng Prefecture was placed under the Long-Jian military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Prefecture was transferred to the Long-Jian military commissioner.

translations.literal: 894, first year of the Qianning era.
translations.idiomatic: 894 CE, first year of the Qianning reign.

sentences.zh: 更感義軍節度曰昭武軍節度。

translations.literal: The Ganyi Army military commissioner was redesignated as Zhaowu Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Ganyi Army military commissioner was renamed Zhaowu Army military commissioner.

translations.literal: 898 CE, first year of the Guanghua reign.
translations.idiomatic: 898 CE, first year of the Guanghua reign.

sentences.zh: 升昭信軍防禦為節度使。

translations.literal: The Zhaoxin Army defense commissioner was promoted to military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhaoxin Army defense commissioner was elevated to military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 蓬、壁二州隸武定軍節度。

translations.literal: Peng and Bi prefectures—two in all—were placed under the Wuding Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Peng and Bi prefectures were transferred to the Wuding Army military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 置武貞軍節度使，領澧、朗、漵三州，治澧州。

translations.literal: The Wuzhen Army military commissioner was established, holding Li, Lang, and Xu prefectures—three in all—with seat at Li Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Wuzhen Army military commissioner was appointed, commanding Li, Lang, and Xu prefectures from Li Prefecture.

translations.literal: The Bazhou defense commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: A Bazhou defense commissioner was appointed.

translations.literal: 901, first year of the Tianfu era.
translations.idiomatic: 901 CE, first year of the Tianfu reign.

translations.literal: The Zhaowu Army military commissioner discontinued jurisdiction over Li Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhaowu Army military commissioner relinquished Li Prefecture.

translations.literal: The Lizhou military commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: A Lizhou military commissioner was appointed.

translations.literal: 904, first year of the Tianyou era.
translations.idiomatic: 904 CE, first year of the Tianyou reign.

sentences.zh: 賜昭信軍節度號戎昭軍節度，增領均、房二州。是年，更戎昭軍曰武定軍，徙治均州。

translations.literal: The Zhaoxin Army military commissioner was granted the title Rongzhao Army military commissioner, and Jun and Fang prefectures—two in all—were added to its jurisdiction. In the same year, the Rongzhao Army was redesignated as Wuding Army, and its seat was moved to Jun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhaoxin Army military commissioner was renamed Rongzhao Army military commissioner and gained Jun and Fang prefectures. That year Rongzhao Army became Wuding Army, with headquarters moved to Jun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 山南西道節度罷領巴、渠、開三州，升巴州防禦使為渠、巴、開三州團練觀察使。

translations.literal: The Shannan West Circuit military commissioner discontinued jurisdiction over Ba, Qu, and Kai prefectures—three in all; the Bazhou defense commissioner was promoted to Ba-Qu-Kai Three Prefectures training and observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Shannan West military commissioner relinquished Ba, Qu, and Kai prefectures; the Bazhou defense commissioner was elevated to training and observation commissioner for those three prefectures.

sentences.zh: 忠義軍節度復為山南東道節度。廢武定軍節度，復以均、房二州隸山南東道節度。

translations.literal: The Zhongyi Army military commissioner was again changed to Shannan East Circuit military commissioner. The Wuding Army military commissioner was abolished; Jun and Fang prefectures—two in all—were again placed under the Shannan East Circuit military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhongyi Army military commissioner reverted to Shannan East military command. The Wuding Army military commissioner was abolished, and Jun and Fang prefectures were restored to Shannan East jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 利州節度增領閬、陵、榮、果、蓬、通六州，更號利閬節度。

translations.literal: The Lizhou military commissioner added Lang, Ling, Rong, Guo, Peng, and Tong prefectures—six in all—to its jurisdiction and was redesignated Lizhou-Lang military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Lizhou military commissioner gained six prefectures—Lang, Ling, Rong, Guo, Peng, and Tong—and was renamed the Lizhou-Lang military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 置興文節度使，領興、文、集、壁四州，治興州。

translations.literal: The Xingwen military commissioner was established, holding Xing, Wen, Ji, and Bi prefectures—four in all—with seat at Xing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Xingwen military commissioner was appointed, commanding four prefectures—Xing, Wen, Ji, and Bi—from his seat at Xing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 升夔忠涪防禦使為鎮江節度使。

translations.literal: The Kuizhong-Fu defense commissioner was promoted to Zhenjiang military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Kuizhong-Fu defense commissioner was elevated to Zhenjiang military commissioner.

translations.literal: Wen Prefecture was placed under the Xingwen military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Prefecture was transferred to the Xingwen military commissioner.
